plan.analysis: Exploratory stage-model fidelity; no pathology or molecular labels. Two already-examined slides; not a prospective validation.
plan.estimator: Source-slide median imputation, standardized features, multinomial logistic regression C=1,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=2000; no held-out-slide hyperparameter selection.
plan.interpretation: Fidelity to the published stage classifier; never biological stage accuracy, clinical risk, or original-model causal attribution.

feature_definitions.log_area: Natural logarithm of original candidate area in mm²
feature_definitions.other_features: Median raster-derived cell measurements among usable linked masks within the original candidate.
